arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 10 c.concept_name AS diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_occurrences, COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patients_with_diagnosis
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = co.person_id
JOIN omop.concept g ON g.concept_id = p.gender_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
WHERE g.concept_name = 'FEMALE'
  AND (2026 - p.year_of_birth) BETWEEN 50 AND 59
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.cohort ch WHERE ch.subject_id = p.person_id)
GROUP BY c.concept_name
ORDER BY diagnosis_occurrences DESC, patients_with_diagnosis DESC;

SELECT TOP 20 g.concept_id, g.concept_name, p.gender_source_value, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM omop.person p
LEFT JOIN omop.concept g ON g.concept_id = p.gender_concept_id
GROUP BY g.concept_id, g.concept_name, p.gender_source_value
ORDER BY n DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cohort_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS cohort_subjects FROM omop.cohort;
SELECT MIN(year_of_birth) AS min_yob, MAX(year_of_birth) AS max_yob, COUNT(*) AS persons FROM omop.person;

SELECT TOP 10 c.concept_name AS diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_occurrences, COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patients_with_diagnosis
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = co.person_id
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
WHERE p.gender_concept_id = 8532
  AND (YEAR(co.condition_start_date) - p.year_of_birth) BETWEEN 50 AND 59
  AND co.condition_concept_id <> 0
GROUP BY c.concept_name
ORDER BY diagnosis_occurrences DESC, patients_with_diagnosis DESC;

Among women aged 50–59 at the time of diagnosis, the most frequent diagnosis by occurrence count is **Primary malignant neoplasm of breast**.

- Diagnosis occurrences: **344,661**
- Distinct patients: **6,740**

Note: the `omop.cohort` table is empty, so I interpreted “our cohort” as the available OMOP clinical dataset rather than a populated cohort table.
